text: I think you'll enjoy making and eating these delicious Brown Edge Wafers. The recipe features eggs, which are a staple in many of your liked recipes, and butter, which is often used in combination with heavy cream in your preferred dishes. The short preparation time of 30 minutes is also in line with the cooking time of many recipes you've liked in the past. While the nutritional content is relatively low, it's not drastically different from other recipes you've enjoyed.
